answer_1.quote: We propose ABLE: an Adaptive, Bespoke, Listen, and Empathetic conversational support system tailored specifically for individuals with physical disabilities... leveraging PERPDSCD, ABLE is developed in a reinforcement learning framework...

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation Metrics: We employ four metrics to evaluate persona accuracy (PCA), gender-age accuracy (GAA), politeness accuracy (PA), and empathy accuracy (EA). ... We also evaluate ABLE in terms of language and dialogue quality using three metrics: Perplexity (PPL), Response Length Ratio (R_len), Non-repetitiveness (N_rep).

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation involves 10 evaluators, who were compensated according to the university norms. The evaluation consists of two phases... they rate the conversations based on a Likert scale of 1-5 for seven metrics: persona accuracy, gender-age accuracy, politeness accuracy, empathy accuracy, fluency (FY), consistency (CY), and non-repetitiveness (NR).
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators interact with the system and rate each interaction on a 1‑5 Likert scale for the listed metrics.
